reason: Check implementation against the confirmed kernel-only scope and explicit non-goals.
Check data model, state transitions, transaction handoff, and no-HTTP boundary.
Check that Webhook and other future capabilities do not leak into current acceptance.
Check which historical requirements belong to the kernel and which remain deferred to Webhook/adapters.
Check models, migrations, constraints, comments, audit fields, and enum persistence.
Check task arguments, PostgreSQL facts, at-least-once behavior, leases, and failure recovery.
Check every delivery transition, illegal transition, duplicate command, stale worker, and terminal behavior.
Check event identifiers and payload redaction in structured logs and exception boundaries.
Check module ownership and prevent route/UI or generic registry sprawl.
